fusions.name: Flushing Crack
fusions.desc: A sharp report fills a cone 6 tiles ahead of you, which deals 12 damage to everything caught in it and stuns them for 1 second. Each has a 50% chance of [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Shot Through the Brush
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A shot that deals 26 damage to the first enemy it meets.

fusions.name: Off at the Shot
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Smoke Still Hanging
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your critical hit chance rises by 15% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
